title: Simulation 3D Vision Detection Generator
text: 在 3D 仿真环境中根据测量检测对象和车道；输出 4 路；按 {Radial distortion coefficients} 指定径向畸变系数；{Sensor identifier} 指定唯一传感器标识符、{Parent name} 指定父车辆名称 Scene、{Mounting location} 指定传感器安装位置、{Specify offset} 指定相对于安装位置的偏移、{Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)} 指定相对于安装位置的平移偏移量、{Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} 指定相对于安装位置的旋转偏移量、{Sample time} 指定采样时间、{Types of detections generated by sensor} 指定传感器生成的检测类型 Lanes、{Maximum number of reported detections} 指定报告的最大检测数、{Maximum number of reported lanes} 指定报告的车道最大数量、{Distance from parent for computing lane boundaries} 指定计算车道边界时距父坐标系的距离、{Source of object bus name} 指定目标总线名称来源、{Object bus name} 指定对象总线名称 BusObjectDetections、{Source of output lane bus name} 输出车道总线名称的来源、{Specify an output lane bus name} 指定车道总线名称、{Maximum detection range (m)} 指定最大检测范围、{Bounding box accuracy (pixels)} 指定边界框准确度、{Smoothing filter noise intensity (m/s^2)} 用于对位置和速度测量进行滤波的噪声强度、{Maximum detectable object speed (m/s)} 指定最大可检测对象速度、{Maximum allowed occlusion for detector} 指定对象允许的最大遮挡、{Minimum detectable image size of an object (pixels)} 指定对象的最小高度和宽度、{Probability of detecting a target} 指定检测概率、{Number of false positives per image} 指定视觉传感器每幅图像生成的误检测数、{Minimum lane size in image (pixels)} 指定车道的最大尺寸、{Accuracy of lane boundary (pixels)} 指定车道边界准确度、{Add noise to measurements} 启用向视觉传感器测量值添加噪声、{Select method to specify initial seed} 指定随机数生成器种子的方法、{Initial seed} 指定随机数生成器种子、{Focal length (pixels)} 指定相机焦距、{Optical center (pixels)} 指定相机光心、{Image size (pixels)} 指定相机生成的图像大小、{Tangential distortion coefficients} 指定切向畸变系数、{Skew of the camera axes} 指定相机轴的斜切角、{Output actor truth} 输出目标的真值、{Output lane truth} 输出车道边界的真值，按实例取值。

params.name: Sensor identifier
params.values: 唯一传感器标识符 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Parent name
params.values: 父车辆名称 Scene Origin (default) | vehicle name

params.name: Mounting location
params.values: 传感器安装位置 Origin (default) | Front bumper | Rear bumper | Right mirror | Left mirror | Rearview mirror | Hood center | Roof center |...

params.name: Specify offset
params.values: 指定相对于安装位置的偏移 off (default) | on

params.name: Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)
params.values: 相对于安装位置的平移偏移量 [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: 相对于安装位置的旋转偏移量 [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Sample time
params.values: 采样时间 -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Types of detections generated by sensor
params.values: 传感器生成的检测类型 Lanes and objects (default) | Objects only | Lanes only | Lanes with occlusion

params.name: Maximum number of reported detections
params.values: 报告的最大检测数 50 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Maximum number of reported lanes
params.values: 报告的车道最大数量 30 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Distance from parent for computing lane boundaries
params.values: 计算车道边界时距父坐标系的距离 0:0.5:9.5 (default) | N -element real-valued vector

params.name: Source of object bus name
params.values: 目标总线名称来源 Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Object bus name
params.values: 对象总线名称 BusObjectDetections | valid bus name

params.name: Source of output lane bus name
params.values: 输出车道总线名称的来源 Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Specify an output lane bus name
params.values: 车道总线名称 BusLaneDetections (default) | valid bus name

params.name: Maximum detection range (m)
params.values: 最大检测范围 150 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Bounding box accuracy (pixels)
params.values: 边界框准确度 5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Smoothing filter noise intensity (m/s^2)
params.values: 用于对位置和速度测量进行滤波的噪声强度 5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Maximum detectable object speed (m/s)
params.values: 最大可检测对象速度 50 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Maximum allowed occlusion for detector
params.values: 对象允许的最大遮挡 0.5 (default) | real scalar in the range [0 1)

params.name: Minimum detectable image size of an object (pixels)
params.values: 对象的最小高度和宽度 [15,15] (default) | 1-by-2 vector of positive values

params.name: Probability of detecting a target
params.values: 检测概率 0.9 (default) | positive real scalar less than or equal to 1

params.name: Number of false positives per image
params.values: 视觉传感器每幅图像生成的误检测数 0.1 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Minimum lane size in image (pixels)
params.values: 车道的最大尺寸 [20,3] (default) | 1-by-2 real-valued vector

params.name: Accuracy of lane boundary (pixels)
params.values: 车道边界准确度 3 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Add noise to measurements
params.values: 启用向视觉传感器测量值添加噪声 on (default) | off

params.name: Select method to specify initial seed
params.values: 指定随机数生成器种子的方法 Repeatable (default) | Specify seed | Not repeatable

params.name: Initial seed
params.values: 随机数生成器种子 1 (default) | nonnegative integer less than 2 32

params.name: Focal length (pixels)
params.values: 相机焦距 [800,800] (default) | two-element real-valued vector

params.name: Optical center (pixels)
params.values: 相机光心 [320,240] (default) | two-element real-valued vector

params.name: Image size (pixels)
params.values: 相机生成的图像大小 [480,640] (default) | two-element vector of positive integers

params.name: Radial distortion coefficients
params.values: 径向畸变系数 [0,0] (default) | two-element real-valued vector | three-element real-valued vector

params.name: Tangential distortion coefficients
params.values: 切向畸变系数 [0,0] (default) | two-element real-valued vector

params.name: Skew of the camera axes
params.values: 相机轴的斜切角 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Output actor truth
params.values: 输出目标的真值 off (default) | on

params.name: Output lane truth
params.values: 输出车道边界的真值 off (default) | on
